title: AI Infrastructure ETF Atlas
performance_method: Unadjusted closing market-price change; distributions excluded. Each series starts at its first 2026 close or inception.

funds.name: Defiance AI & Power Infrastructure ETF
funds.mandate: U.S.-listed companies tied to AI hardware, data centers, power generation, utilities, construction and grid equipment.
funds.index: MarketVector US Listed AI & Power Infrastructure Index
funds.risk: Broad mandate creates overlap with both industrial and semiconductor sleeves; free-float weighting can concentrate winners.

funds.name: First Trust Nasdaq Clean Edge Smart Grid Infrastructure Index Fund
funds.mandate: Global smart-grid and electric-infrastructure companies across components, engineering, utilities, storage and enabling software.
funds.index: Nasdaq Clean Edge Smart Grid Infrastructure Index
funds.risk: A global industrial portfolio, not an AI-pure-play; project cycles, rates, regulation and currency can dominate AI demand.

funds.name: Roundhill Photonics & Optics ETF
funds.mandate: A concentrated global basket of optical interconnect, laser, photonic-chip, transceiver and fiber-connectivity companies.
funds.risk: Only weeks of trading history; concentrated exposure to rapid product cycles, export controls and customer capex timing.

top_holdings.name: Suzhou TFC Optical Communication Co Ltd

funds.name: Roundhill Memory ETF
funds.mandate: A targeted global basket of companies producing HBM, DRAM, NAND, SSD and other memory or storage technologies.
funds.risk: Extreme cycle and pricing sensitivity; a small global supplier set creates geographic, policy and single-industry concentration.

funds.name: Roundhill Neocloud ETF
funds.mandate: A targeted basket of GPU-as-a-Service platforms, AI/HPC data centers and digital miners pivoting to compute infrastructure.
funds.risk: Exposure aggregates direct shares and swaps; CRWV 25.60% = 5.66% shares + 19.94% swaps. Holdings date follows the issuer display (September 3; file Date September 4). Only weeks of trading history; leverage, customer concentration, financing needs and buildout execution can overwhelm demand growth.

funds.name: Global X Data Center & Digital Infrastructure ETF
funds.mandate: Global data-center operators, REITs, communications towers and other digital infrastructure supporting network growth.
funds.index: Solactive Data Center REITs & Digital Infrastructure Index
funds.risk: Real-estate and tower weights make rates, financing and tenancy as important as AI; less direct compute upside than pure plays.

analytics.verdict: Since Aug 6, all six are lower; the single-bottleneck funds swing 3.0× as much as the broad baskets.

headlines.holdings: Five names hold 68–82% of each single-bottleneck fund.
headlines.compare: The purest funds are the youngest.
